optimizedDescription.value: DiffGenerator turns preview base/merged file content into presentation-neutral unified diffs for PreviewSpec.

optimizedContext.value:
# DiffGenerator

## Rules

- TypeScript `interface` named `DiffGenerator` with single method `generate`. NOT abstract class.
- `generate({ filename, base, merged, contextLines? })` — `filename` artifact name (e.g. `spec.md`); `base` original; `merged` after change; optional context lines. Empty `base` allowed for newly introduced artifacts.
- Returns plain unified diff string: no ANSI, no terminal control sequences, no host-specific separators. Labels: `a/<filename> (base)`, `b/<filename> (merged)`.
- Dedicated typed failure `DiffGenerationError` for non-fatal review-surface problems after merge succeeded. Default impl raises when concrete mechanism fails usable unified diff. Lets `PreviewSpec` distinguish failed diff surface vs failed merge/preview.
- Omitted `contextLines` → default impl uses 3 lines (CLI-compatible).
- Core MUST provide default implementation factory for config-based composition. Concrete library choice encapsulated behind port.
- Internal core capability for shared preview (`PreviewSpec`); MUST NOT force delivery mechanisms for unrelated diff workflows.

## Constraints

- Lives in `application/ports/` per hexagonal structure.
- Port MUST NOT depend directly on concrete diff library.
- Plain text only; colorization/host presentation outside port.
- Models file-to-file unified diffs; not semantic review comments or artifact filtering.
- Caller-handled failures MUST surface via `DiffGenerationError`, not anonymous library-specific errors.
